primitive.meaning: ensure-ntp for a provider outcome; invalid when request intake or operation raised.

changed.meaning: True if enabling the selected unit exited zero, independent of the subsequent synchronization result.

providers.meaning: Provider names considered, when none is installed.

provider.meaning: First installed provider, in the order systemd-timesyncd, chrony, ntpd.

unit.meaning: Service unit for the selected provider.

enable_exit.meaning: Exit status from enabling and starting the provider.

post_apply.meaning: timedatectl show/status results and parsed properties.

values.meaning: Properties parsed from show and filled from status when absent; may include NTPSynchronized, NTP and Timezone.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Unnormalized exception text can also be returned; those values are not a finite enum.
